question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**help**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is: *“Engaging in activities like meditation and exercise can (3) ______ manage stress levels.”*
 
• The subject here is the phrase **“activities like meditation and exercise”**, which is plural.
 
• After the modal verb **“can”**, we always use the base form of the verb.
 
• Therefore, the correct verb form is **help**. 

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Helps:** Incorrect because after “can,” the base form of the verb is required.
 
• **Adds:** Does not match the meaning of the sentence about stress management.
 
• **Add:** Grammatically possible but contextually inappropriate.
